title: GooberPack
description: silly goober resource pack, with 6 features as of now.
body:
![rainbow bar](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9742f11434e944718ecf418a368be5af06e10ba9.gif)

GooberPack Features 6 things as of now :3
- 3 new music discs (With RGB)
- 3 new paintings
- Little image on white bed
- Totem of undying reskin
- Lodestone reskin (companion cube)
- Netherite sword reskin (black knife)

![rainbow bar](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9742f11434e944718ecf418a368be5af06e10ba9.gif)
